content.name: Survivor
entries: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

content.name: Survivor
entries: You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle, giving you these benefits.

entries.name: Defy Death
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|SRD52|Death Saving Throws}. Moreover, when you roll 18–20 on a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|SRD52}, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

entries.name: Heroic Rally
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are {@status Bloodied|SRD52} and have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.
